changelog: Consolidated release of the storage protection and restore activity work from 3.2.97 and 3.2.98 — no new changes over 3.2.98

Storage Protection: a disk guard watches free space on the backup volume every 10 minutes and escalates — warn at 75%, alert at 85%, and at 93% it pauses new file and image backups so the volume cannot fill. UrBackup's nightly cleanup reclaims space and backups resume automatically below 70% (issue #18)

Fix: retention floors could exceed their ceilings (min_file_incr was 40 against a max of 20), silently stopping UrBackup from pruning old backups. Floors are realigned and the server now rejects any settings save where a min_* is not below its max_* (issue #18)

Fix: restore activities were missing from the Activities page entirely — UrBackup records restores in its own table, which St0r never read. File and image restores now appear alongside backups with a Restores filter, restore badges, and the restored path on hover (issue #17)
Settings gains a Storage Protection tab with live usage, guard event history, and admin actions to reclaim space or prune orphaned files the UrBackup database no longer references
Retention floors (min full/incremental, file and image) are now editable in Backup Defaults, and the 'no_images' toggle is correctly labelled as disabling image backups rather than 'Headless Mode'
